reference_sql:
SELECT ch.channel_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(a.spend_date) = 1 THEN a.spend ELSE 0 END) AS q1_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(a.spend_date) = 2 THEN a.spend ELSE 0 END) AS q2_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(a.spend_date) = 3 THEN a.spend ELSE 0 END) AS q3_eur,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(a.spend_date) = 4 THEN a.spend ELSE 0 END) AS q4_eur
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ch.channel_name
alternatives:
SELECT channel_name, COALESCE(q1, 0) AS q1_eur, COALESCE(q2, 0) AS q2_eur, COALESCE(q3, 0) AS q3_eur, COALESCE(q4, 0) AS q4_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign and day of 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, quarter(a.spend_date) AS qtr, a.spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
) AS s
PIVOT (SUM(spend) FOR qtr IN (1 AS q1, 2 AS q2, 3 AS q3, 4 AS q4) GROUP BY channel_name)

SELECT ch.channel_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date < DATE '2025-04-01'), 0) AS q1_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2025-07-01'), 0) AS q2_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.spend_date < DATE '2025-10-01'), 0) AS q3_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-10-01'), 0) AS q4_eur
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ch.channel_name

SELECT ch.channel_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'), 0) AS q1_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'), 0) AS q2_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'), 0) AS q3_eur,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.spend) FILTER (WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'), 0) AS q4_eur
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = cp.channel_id
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
